question:
For $f(x)=\operatorname{cosec}^{-1}\left(\frac{2}{x-1}\right)$:

(i) determine the domain;

(ii) obtain the range by examining the values taken by $\frac{2}{x-1}$.
explanation:
Condition for inverse cosecant
The function $\operatorname{cosec}^{-1}u$ is defined when $|u|\geq1$. Therefore, $$\left|\frac{2}{x-1}\right|\geq1,$$ with $x\neq1$.

These intervals cover the complete domain of the inverse cosecant function. Therefore, its complete principal range is obtained.
